violation_type.title: People Whose Behavior/Health Threatens Children Not Present (26 TAC §747.3503(a))
violation_type.short_title: People Whose Behavior/Health Threatens Children Not Present
violation_type.typical_finding: The primary caregiver allowed an individual with an ineligible background check to be present at the operation. This was corrected during the inspection when the individual left the operation.

finding_variants.text: The primary caregiver allowed an individual with an ineligible background check to be present at the operation. This was corrected during the inspection when the individual left the operation.
A registered sex-offender was registered to the home and had daily access to the children.
